bio: South of Maipú, inside the Antigal Winery & Estates facilities, you will find a modern restaurant surrounded by vineyards and overlooking the mountains. The menu is the brainchild of chef Gonzalo Castro, who seeks to connect the area's culinary memory with fire and, of course, with the essence of Argentine flavours. After the bold appetisers, which are rather creative and inspired by the season, both the executive menu (Pausa Mendocina) and the gastronomic menus (Origen Andino, with 4 courses, and Influencias & Legado, with 7 courses) showcase a cuisine that is contemporary in its ambition but quite local in character, as the chef has expertly uncovered the roots of the Mendoza region. The tasting menus include selected wine pairings!
